summary: Public projects created on 31 October 2026: 4 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: New repositories covered agent tooling and dictation cleanup, with an agent plugin for capturing mid-thread ideas into in-repo sprints and a catalogue of LoRA format adapters on a small dictation model. Two further repositories documented conversational AI triage and batch inference mechanics on OpenRouter. On Hugging Face, the new dataset was a reference list of OpenRouter batch-capable models with batch and sync prices.
